description: Source code implementing Vulkan-based tensor slicing operations for PyTorch, including functions for 4D slicing, width, height, and general slice handling, with Vulkan API integration.

methods.name: slice_4d
methods.description: Performs a 4D slice operation on a Vulkan tensor, setting up compute shader parameters and dispatching the job.

methods.name: slice_width
methods.description: Slices a tensor along the width dimension, optimized for step=1 with copy or multiple copy operations.

methods.name: slice_height
methods.description: Slices a tensor along the height dimension, optimized for step=1 with copy or multiple copy operations.

methods.name: slice
methods.description: Main function to perform tensor slicing along a specified dimension with optional start, end, and step parameters, dispatching to specialized functions based on dimension.
